newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Wegener to acquire regional Dutch paper.
newsitem.headline: Wegener to acquire regional Dutch paper.

text.p: Dutch publisher Wegener NV said it expected to purchase the remaining two thirds of the shares in regional newspaper publisher PZC Holding BV.

PZC publishes the Provinciale Zeeuwse Courant which has a daily circulation of 61,000 in Zeeland province and several other local and regional titles. The company made a net profit of 1.4 million guilders in 1995 on revenues of 66.9 million and expects a net profit of over two million guilders for 1996.
Wegener, which has held a third of PZC's shares since 1981, said it would pay for the remaining shares in cash but gave no further details.
